course_name_original: Diseño y cálculo de instalaciones eléctricas en baja tensión y alta tensión
course_name_en: Design and Calculation of Low and High Voltage Electrical Installations

learning_outcomes.text: To provide students with a scientific and technical foundation that allows them to know, understand, and perform calculations related to electrical energy distribution systems in Medium and Low Voltage (networks, lines, transformation centers, measurements, and applicable regulations).
That students know the different techniques and management involved in the design and construction of Low and High Voltage installations.
Be able to direct the assembly and commissioning of B.T. and A.T. installations within their competencies.
Understanding and interpreting texts and data, developing skills for their concretization and clear and concise presentation.
Aptitude for the distribution of resources and time and their implementation in real situations.
Ability to transmit concepts, ideas, processes, etc., related to Industrial Engineering orally and in writing, clearly and correctly.
Ability to work collaboratively and develop multidisciplinary projects.
Ability to relate to other people and an open attitude towards creating new relationships.
Ability to incorporate new knowledge in the area of Industrial Engineering, based on the acquired training and necessary for the evolution of technique.

syllabus_topics: BASIC CONCEPTS. Fundamental characteristics of the energy and electrical sectors. Units of energy measurement. Structure of an electrical system.

General Basic Knowledge of Electric Power Generation Plants. Electric Power Plants. Hydroelectric Power Plants. Conventional Thermal Power Plants. Nuclear Power Plants. Renewable Energy Power Plants. The Alternator. The Turbine.

TRANSFORMATION STATIONS. Classification. Transformers. Transformation Centers. Cells. Standard designs for Transformation Centers (Compact, integrated. Outdoor. Underground). Regulations on Electric Power Plants, Substations and Transformation Centers.
UNDERGROUND HIGH VOLTAGE LINES. Conductors (Constitution, designation and types). Splices and terminations. Installation and laying. Grounding techniques. Basic knowledge of electrical calculation.

OVERHEAD HIGH VOLTAGE LINES. Classification. Conductors (Classification, nature, characteristics). Laying. Splices. Safety distances. Electrical parameters. Actions to consider in electrical and mechanical calculation.

HARDWARE AND INSULATORS. Hardware: Fastening of insulators to the support, fastening of conductors to insulators. Insulators: Constitution, Types of insulators, tests, mechanical calculation, electrical calculation (effect of environmental contamination) insulation level, creepage distance. Damping devices. AVIFAUNA protection.
SUPPORTS AND FOUNDATIONS. Classification of supports. Types of supports (assembly). Types of crossarms (assembly), foundations. Mechanical calculation, actions to consider. Grounding of supports.

SECTIONING, SWITCHING AND PROTECTION EQUIPMENT. Disconnectors, circuit breakers, automatic circuit breakers, current limiting fuses and expulsion fuses. Main characteristics and installation methods. Overvoltage protection (line shielding; Lightning arresters and self-regulating valves).

DOCUMENTATION AND COMMISSIONING OF HIGH VOLTAGE LINES. Project (Qualified technician). Project content (ITC-LAT 09). Commissioning of lines owned by transmission and distribution companies. Commissioning of lines NOT owned by transmission and distribution companies.
INTRODUCTION TO B.T. ELECTRICAL INSTALLATIONS. Low Voltage Electrotechnical Regulation. Specific company standards. Conduction, wiring and installation materials in B.T.

CONNECTION INSTALLATIONS. Low Voltage Supply. Load forecasting. Connection installations. Specific standards for connection installations in buildings mainly for housing. Specific standards for connection installations in buildings for shops, offices and industries. Schemes.

GENERAL ELECTRICAL INSTALLATIONS. Notions of Low Voltage distribution networks. Electrical connections. General protection boxes. Measurement equipment. Individual derivations. Distribution boards. Notions of conductor calculation. Circuit design. Schemes.
PROTECTION OF PERSONS AGAINST DIRECT AND INDIRECT CONTACTS. Risks from electric current passage. Protection against direct contacts. Protection against indirect contacts.
GROUNDING INSTALLATIONS. Introduction. Soil resistivity. Grounding in buildings. Grounding of supports.

ELECTRICAL STUDY OF DISTRIBUTION NETWORKS. Electrical criteria for section calculation. Load calculation. Line calculation. Protection calculation. Distribution of equipment and mechanisms. Grounding. Calculation of section considering conductor heating. Calculation of section considering voltage drop. Plans and schemes. Regulations. Plans and schemes. Regulations.

LOW VOLTAGE ELECTRIC POWER DISTRIBUTION NETWORKS. Overhead networks. Overhead networks for energy distribution. Classification of distribution networks. Conductors in outdoor installations (Maximum permissible currents). Overhead networks with twisted conductors. Networks with insulated conductors laid on facades. Networks with bare conductors. Underground networks for energy distribution. Maximum permissible currents. Standard designs for low voltage underground networks. Standard designs for low voltage overhead networks.
teaching_methods: Theoretical academic sessions (oral presentation with computer support)
Practical sessions in the classroom (problem solving)
Online monitoring activities via Studium platform
Autonomous problem solving (some exercises are mandatory for evaluation)
assessment_rules: Assessment is based on a blend of guided practical work (40%), a practical exam (40%), and continuous assessment (20%). The evaluation systems include a face-to-face exam of theoretical and practical knowledge, attendance at theoretical and practical classes, and mandatory submission of assigned work. Students are recommended to attend classes and seminars, study, solve exercises, and submit assigned work continuously, making use of tutorials.
